item.title: Malcolm X - World Wide Revolution
item.description:
## Summary

In this 1965 speech, Malcolm X discusses the interconnectedness of global liberation movements and the fight for civil rights in the United States. He frames Black struggles within the broader context of anti-colonial resistance and international human rights.
